name: Pre-Engagement - Documents & Timing
command: # The 7 documents and when each is signed
description: Pre-Engagement - Documents & Timing - reference (methodology, not a runnable command).
notes:
Order and timing:
1. NDA - after initial contact.
2. Scoping Questionnaire - before the pre-engagement meeting.
3. Scoping Document - during the pre-engagement meeting.
4. Penetration Testing Proposal / SoW (Contract) - during pre-engagement.
5. Rules of Engagement (RoE) - before kick-off.
6. Contractors Agreement (physical assessments) - before kick-off.
7. Reports - during and after the test.
Authorized signatories: CEO/CTO/CISO/CSO/CRO/CIO, VP Internal Audit, Director of IT/InfoSec.

examples.label: Document 1 — NDA (sign first, before any discussion)
examples.command: # Mutual NDA signed before sharing any scope details with client

examples.label: Document 4 — Rules of Engagement
examples.command: # RoE defines: in-scope IPs, allowed techniques, emergency contacts, test hours

examples.label: Document 7 — Debriefing report (sign-off after findings walk-through)
examples.command: # Final meeting: walk through findings, get written acceptance, hand over report
